hero.label: Made for Respan
hero.headline: I want to help Respan own the AI observability category from day one.
hero.subheadline: AI-native teams are shipping production agents faster than anyone knows how to monitor them, and Respan is building the infrastructure layer that makes that safe and scalable. That is a genuinely important problem at a genuinely early moment, and I want to be the person making the first calls that bring those teams in. My background selling AI tooling at Copygen.ai means I already know how to earn trust with technical buyers who have heard every pitch.

whyCompany.title: Respan sits at the exact bottleneck every AI team hits in production
whyCompany.body: Every company racing to ship agents runs into the same wall: they have no idea what their agent is actually doing once it is live. Respan solves observability, evals, and optimization in one platform, which means it is not a nice-to-have but a prerequisite for responsible deployment. That is a compelling story to tell, and compelling stories make cold outreach work.

whyCompany.title: Getting in early on an AI infrastructure category is a rare opportunity
whyCompany.body: The market for AI agent tooling is forming right now, and the SDR who helps Respan build its outbound motion today will have a front-row seat to how an entire category gets defined. Early-stage startups reward people who figure things out rather than follow playbooks, which is exactly how I learned to sell at Copygen.ai. I want to be at a company where my reps genuinely shape the pipeline strategy, not just execute it.

whyCompany.title: I have already sold AI tooling to technical buyers using cold outreach
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold sequences targeting developers and ops teams, used HubSpot to manage follow-up, and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from a standing start. At NextAfter I learned how B2B content and messaging actually moves buyers through a funnel at a data-obsessed consultancy. Selling Respan to AI-native engineering teams is a natural next step from both of those experiences.

quote: I spent over a year convincing technical buyers that an AI tool was worth their time and budget, so I know the objections and I know how to get past them. Respan is the kind of product I would have wanted to sell the whole time.
